messages:
maria: FYI BrightCart on dedicated pool 'abc-az' is reporting 429s during a small surge. Looks like autoscaler didn't spin up above min_replicas fast enough.

sam: When did this start? any repro steps or customer logs?

maria: Started ~13:02 UTC. Traffic jump to ~350 rps. Pool metrics show min_replicas=2 but pods remained 2 and readiness was "attach-wait" for ~90s. Customer saw latency spikes and 429s.

javier: Any attach/auth errors in the node logs? Could be token refresh issues or registry throttling. :thinking: 

maria: Paste from pod: ```
2025-11-04T13:02:15Z attach: handshake start
2025-11-04T13:02:18Z attach: auth_refresh failed status=500 retry=1
2025-11-04T13:02:25Z probe: rate_limited status=429
2025-11-04T13:03:45Z autoscaler: desired=8 current=2 event=scale_blocked reason=min_floor_locked
```

linda: Not seeing ImagePull errors. This looks like attach handshake + probe failures blocking readiness.

sam: Can you grab autoscaler events? Maybe min-floor logic hit because pods were unready for too long. Also double-check billing/quotas.

support-bot: BrightCart billing status: ACTIVE (no holds) — last invoice processed 2025-11-03.

maria: Confirmed billing ACTIVE. No invoice holds.

ops-bot: INCIDENT created INC-4950 for BrightCart surge/scale-lag.

maria: Repro steps I ran locally against a staging pool: 1) run `rictl surge --project brightcart --qps 600 --concurrency 50 --duration 60` 2) tail `/internal/v1/pool/metrics` 3) watch spawn_delay and attach_time. Observed spawn_delay > 90s, attach_time spike to 35s.

javier: Autoscaler log snippet: ```
2025-11-04T13:02:16Z autoscaler: scale_decision desired=8 current=2
2025-11-04T13:02:20Z autoscaler: scale_blocked reason=min_floor_locked detail="attach-probe-unready,auth_refresh_failed"
```

linda: Hypothesis: KMS/registry token refresh hitting transient 5xx causing attach handshake to fail; pods never pass attach probe so autoscaler considers them unready and refuses to increase further due to min-floor safety.

sam: Mitigation plan: temporarily bump min_replicas to 6 for that pool and force warm-pool fill. Command: `rictl pool update --pool abc-az --min-replicas 6` and `rictl warmpool fill --pool abc-az --count 4` — then monitor.

maria: Applying patch now, will watch metrics. Also enabling extra probe retries (15s -> 5 retries) for 30m.

support-bot: Customer notified: "We saw latency improve around 13:03:20 after temporary scaling actions." :white_check_mark:

javier: Follow-ups: 1) correlate KMS latency/5xx at 13:02–13:04; 2) add autoscaler metric `autoscaler.block_reason` to alerts; 3) harden attach auth retry/backoff so readiness doesn't permanently block scale; 4) verify billing logic isn't accidentally toggling min-floor.

linda: I'll open infra-KMS ticket and assign to @javier (TKT-789).

sam: Also consider a short-term product feature: allow autoscaler to provision extra reserved warm-nodes for customers that hit repeated surge patterns (BrightCart is repeat offender).

ops-bot: Linked INC-4950 -> TKT-789; priority P2.

maria: After bumping min_replicas we saw 4 pods become ready within ~40s and customer 429s stopped. Monitoring for 24h. Will post postmortem if we hit recurrence.

deploy-bot: automated check — warmpool fill job completed successfully for pool abc-az (job-id wpf-20251104-001).

maria: Closing loop here for now. Thanks all — I'll update after 24h and attach metric charts (spawn_delay, attach_time, autoscaler.desired/current).
